_comment: Model weights `python -m vibe.modules download` can fetch (F-08). Only permissive licenses on the default path (D-015). A null sha256 means not pinned yet: run `download NAME --pin` once, check the file, then add the printed hash here. `source: package` means the model's pip package downloads its own weights on first use; `source: manual` means a gated download you do by hand.

sface.for: identity embeddings, stay on this machine (D-017)

rfdetr.for: people and COCO objects; N/S live, L offline (D-015)
